thread:
Lina Gomez: Heads up - client wants signed order form + countersigned MSA before POC. They require EU entity signer, customer-managed HSM attestation, and net45. Can legal/finance accept a proxy signer for the EU company? :thinking:

Rajiv Menon: Private deployment + Dedicated pool works for the POC. BYOK/HSM only on Private. What "attestation" format do they expect?

Tasha Lee: Lina - upload the redline and orderform. Proxy signing needs a delegation/POA and we need a PO to validate invoices.

Marco Ruiz: Finance note: net45 ok with PO and credit check. If procurement delays, offer proforma/prepay to unblock provisioning. Also need billing entity + VAT number.

Lina Gomez: Uploaded files: https://drive.redwood.example/Ascend_Orderform_v4.pdf and Ascend_MSA_redline.docx

Tasha Lee: Redline snippet: "Customer-managed HSM with attestation and audit report." Our counter: customer-managed HSM allowed for Private only; require independent attestation within 30 days of go-live else revert to Redwood-managed KMS. I'll add tracked changes.

Nina Park: Security flagged data residency, encryption-at-rest, rotation cadence, and escrow policy on their questionnaire. Point them to our standard crypto QA: https://redwood.internal/secure/crypto-faq :white_check_mark:

Rajiv Menon: For signature flow they want billing contact -> legal -> exec. DocuSign chained envelopes are fine. Proposed recipient order: [billing_contact, legal_counsel, exec_signatory]. EU proxy OK with delegation docs.

Tasha Lee: For EU proxy we require either notarized POA, board resolution, or signed letter of delegation plus corporate registry match. Scanned docs acceptable if registry shows authorized signatory.

Marco Ruiz: Who's the invoice recipient? That decides VAT and PO validation. Lina pls confirm.

Lina Gomez: They told us invoices to "Ascend EU Services Ltd" (VAT: EU-ASC-7721). Procurement estimates ~2 weeks for PO.

Marco Ruiz: We can invoice to that entity but will place account on credit hold until PO. Proforma available if they prepay.

Tasha Lee: SLA ask? They requested 99.99% with credits. That's heavy. We can offer 99.95% for Dedicated with capped credits. 99.99% requires multi-region Dedicated and an SLA uplift fee; product/ops must approve.

Rajiv Menon: Ops: 4 nines is feasible only with cross-region failover and extra redundancy; will increase cost. I'll model the uplift and ops constraints.

Tasha Lee: Proposed compromise: conditional 99.99% available as an add-on if customer commits to 12-month reserved capacity and pays the SLA uplift. Adds approval gate but protects us.

docu_sign_bot: Envelope created for MSA/orderform. Recipients: Tasha Lee, Lina Gomez, billing_contact. Envelope ID: env_01b2c3.

Lina Gomez: Customer wants countersign by COB Friday. Legal - doable?

Tasha Lee: Tight but possible if we finalize KMS and SLA counters by tomorrow morning. I will upload tracked changes and route back to the envelope.

Marco Ruiz: Once signed, billing to queue provisioning. If they choose prepay, send billing contact and I'll issue proforma.

Lina Gomez: Next steps: Tasha to post counters, Marco confirm proforma/credit process, Rajiv to return ops cost for 99.99% multi-region, Lina to request delegation docs from customer. Thanks! :thumbsup:
